message.content:
**vllm-ascend** is an Ascend NPU (Huawei CANN/Ascend 910-series) backend plugin for the vLLM inference engine, maintained as a fork of the upstream `vllm-project/vllm-ascend` project with periodic upstream merges.

**Structure:** `vllm_ascend/` holds the plugin — platform/device abstractions, `worker/` (model runner, EPLB), `attention/` (MLA, sparse attention), `compilation/` (ACL graph capture, graph fusion passes), `quantization/`, `spec_decode/` (Eagle, Medusa, ngram, DFlash, DSpark proposers), `lora/` (Punica), `sample/`, `weight_switch/`, `ec_manager/`, `xlite/`, and `observability/` (memory accounting, run logs, request timing).

**Focus:** heavy emphasis on 310P-class hardware — many design docs target DeepSeek-V4.1, GLM-5.x, MiniMax-M3, and Qwen3.8 "Flash-Next" 1M-context on 310P, plus KV-cache offloading, chunked pipeline parallelism, context/disaggregated prefill, and dynamic topology planning.

**Activity:** ~1,000+ commits since Sept 2025, dominated by fixes and performance work, with substantial test and docs coverage.
